name: WELLCHIP
recent: Well Chip 的可弃权附加股（1 股供 5 股，每股 RM1.00）已获超额认购 23.33%，供股股份将于 2026 年 11 月 17 日上市。多名董事在 10 月于场外交易中出售了附加股权益。最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）营收和净利均较上一季度下滑。
notable: 可弃权附加股获超额认购 23.33%，共收到 148,000,843 股有效认购及额外申请。
附加股发行 120,000,000 股新股，发售价每股 RM1.00，将于 2026 年 11 月 17 日上市。
2026 年 9 月 3 日股东大会通过附加股议案。
risks: 董事 Ng Hooi Lang 和 Tang Soo Yen 在 10 月于场外交易中出售附加股权益。
附加股发行 1 亿 2,000 万股新股，占现有股本 20%，可能摊薄每股盈利。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 RM71.613 million，环比下降 5.8%，同比增长 8.7%；净利为 RM23.93 million，环比下降 14.2%，同比增长 17.9%；净利率为 33.4%，上一季度为 36.7%。

recent_en: Well Chip's renounceable rights issue (1-for-5 at RM1.00 per share) was oversubscribed by 23.33%, with rights shares to be listed on 17 November 2026. Several directors disposed of rights entitlements in off-market dealings in October. The latest quarter (ended 30 June 2026) saw both revenue and net profit decline quarter-on-quarter.
notable_en: The renounceable rights issue was oversubscribed by 23.33%, with 148,000,843 rights shares validly accepted and excess applied for.
The rights issue involves 120,000,000 new shares at RM1.00 each, to be listed on 17 November 2026.
Shareholders approved the rights issue at the general meeting on 3 September 2026.
risks_en: Directors Ng Hooi Lang and Tang Soo Yen disposed of rights entitlements in off-market dealings in October.
The rights issue of 120 million new shares, representing 20% of existing share capital, may dilute earnings per share.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM71.613 million, down 5.8% QoQ but up 8.7% YoY; net profit was RM23.93 million, down 14.2% QoQ but up 17.9% YoY; net margin was 33.4% versus 36.7% in the previous quarter.
